description: Sets the person's own funnel steps for a website (read by the next refresh), or clears them to go back to the automatic funnel. Needs the person's approval. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.

steps.description: 3 to 6 lines, one step each: visit, engaged, event <name>[, <name>], or page <path>[, <path>] (a path ending in * is a prefix). Empty: back to the automatic funnel.

name: webops_set_funnel_steps
title: Set a website's funnel steps
